comment: Portal's update gate. Installed copies fetch this file from the main branch before every update check (this copy ships in the APK as the fallback). debian_hold: Debian packages Portal must not upgrade until a known problem is fixed. mesa_layer.mode: "vetted" installs only the lfdevs Mesa builds listed in mesa_layer.vetted; "latest" takes any newer build (still on trial with automatic rollback). mesa_layer.blocked and app_blocked are never offered.
